authorization: Maintainer instruction 2026-09-17: convert the Codex skill at src/agents/skills/dev into a Claude Code skill at src/claude/skills named dev. Authorizes writing the converted package only; no installation, host configuration, hook or settings registration, product execution, testing or validation.

requirements.outcome: The Codex dev package is converted to a Claude Code skill at src/claude/skills/dev, preserving its product-implementation contract: specification-selected TDD, integration, QA, evidence and delivery.
Every one of the eleven source files is accounted for with an explicit disposition; no file is silently dropped, and the nine files needing no host change are preserved byte-for-byte.

Codex host mechanics are mapped to Claude Code: the two Codex CLI terminal statements become Claude Code terminal and file tools, and host metadata lives entirely in SKILL.md frontmatter because Claude Code has no separate metadata file.

allowed-tools is derived from the declared capabilities and makes two asserted source boundaries structural: Skill is omitted so the skill cannot invoke a skill-authoring workflow or a package validator, and Task is omitted because the source states delegation is not required.

AskUserQuestion is named at the bounded decision points the source could only express as prose: ambiguous specification selection, an unresolved evidence destination, and an unselected prerequisite document.
The package remains portable: no installation root, repository-specific path, operator path or fixed project output directory is wired into any converted file.

capabilities: Claude Code file tools (Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep) for product source, test and evidence work
Unscoped Bash, because the authored skill derives build, test, formatting, static-analysis and coverage commands from runtime project inputs and no command-name pattern can be fixed in advance
AskUserQuestion for bounded decisions with known options
expected_outputs: Converted Claude Code skill package at the target root, comprising SKILL.md, four references and six asset templates
side_effects: The authored skill, when later run by a user, writes product source, test and evidence files inside the selected project and executes project-derived build and test commands
known_issues: No bound Python evaluation artifacts were created for this package: no evals/, tests/ or scripts/ directory exists. AGENTS.md names such artifacts required for a skill build, while skill-builder forbids generating evaluation campaigns during authoring and the validator package is documented as owning all quality campaigns. Task is omitted from allowed-tools, so the source allowance for separately authorized delegation is structurally unavailable in the converted skill. Recorded as design open question Q2.

A legacy namespaced command remains at src/claude/commands/legacy/dev.md dispatching the spec-driven-dev skill. No file collision exists and the skill was not renamed. Recorded as design open question Q3.
Validation and testing are NOT_PERFORMED for the converted bytes.
